parts.text: The sample stock file shows 40 samosas. Confirm the actual count with the canteen.
We sold 12 samosas. What is the remaining quantity?
After recording the sale in the owner menu, the sample balance would be 28 samosas.
The low-stock warning is five units or fewer. Check the live stock display for current items.
Prioritise products at zero or five units or fewer, then consider recent sales and expected student demand.

summary.session_summary: Demonstration only: owner discussed samosa sales, low-stock monitoring and restocking.
restock_priorities: Use the live stock screen to identify items at or below five units.
